criteria.evidence: claude-egress-check.ps1:144-145 and :96 pass `-b` from $wantSrc, which comes from `-BindIp` or from Get-PhysicalSourceIp (:73-91). That function reads Get-NetRoute and Get-NetIPAddress at run time. No literal <LAN-IP> appears in the script.

Two filters at :81 and :85. Routes whose NextHop matches ^198\.18\. are dropped, and candidate addresses matching ^(169\.254\.|198\.18\.) are dropped. The regex only covers the 198.18.x.x half of <TUN-SUBNET>, so 198.19.x.x would slip through. That is nonblocking; see N2.

Get-PhysicalSourceIp returns $null on failure (:90) inside try/catch. New-TunnelArgs adds `-b` only if SourceIp is non-empty (:96). If the bound start fails, the script stops that process and retries unbound (:150-160). Only if both attempts fail does it exit with code 6. I verified this by reading the code. I did not run it. DELIVERY's test-1 output is consistent with the code.

I could not read the file's bytes. A Grep for a leading EF BB BF found nothing, but ripgrep may strip the BOM, so that result proves nothing either way. The Read tool displayed the Chinese text correctly, which does not distinguish BOM from no BOM. The only evidence is DELIVERY §3, which is the worker's own paste (`EF BB BF size=9250`). Under the contract's red line, I cannot count that as pass.

:207-216 print one of four distinct `[源地址]` lines: bound to physical NIC / unbound after degrade / no -Start so unknown / unbound (TUN). The `degraded` field and the `[动作]` text at :196-198 also differ per outcome.

(1) If the NIC IP changes, the old bound ssh connection stops working. ServerAlive 15 s x 3 should drop it in about 45 s. The script has no reconnect, which matches the 'no auto-reconnect' rule in AGENTS.md. The next run reports code 3 (port not listening), and `-Start` re-detects the IP. (2) If the bind succeeds but the direct route is dead, ConnectTimeout=8 fails the start and the script degrades to TUN. The output then shows 'degraded' with the action text at :156, and the 'both failed' text at :158 names both attempts. All three cases (not bound / bound but unreachable / tinyproxy down) can be told apart. Residual gap: if the port is already listening, the script never looks at where the existing tunnel is bound (the `[源地址]` line then reads 'not recorded', :212-213).

blocking.evidence: Grep `\A(?-u:\xEF\xBB\xBF)` returned 0 matches. That result is untrustworthy because rg handles BOMs itself. Read cannot show raw bytes.

nonblocking.what: The 25-minute direct-connection stability run was unfinished at submission, and the 10-minute run did not pass the 13-minute point where TUN first dropped. DELIVERY §5 acknowledges this. Stability remains inferred from a short window.
The 198.18 exclusion regex does not cover 198.19.x.x, the other half of /15. Change `^198\.18\.` to `^198\.(18|19)\.` at :81 and :85.
Switching Wi-Fi or unplugging the NIC mid-session is untested, and there is no auto-recovery. The failure shows up only on the next check as code 3.

Get-ExitIp (:68) uses `2>$null` while $ErrorActionPreference is 'Stop'. On PowerShell 5.1 this could turn native-command stderr into a terminating error. The result is only an empty egressIp, which becomes code 4. That is safe but gives a misleading message.
The first-round blocking B1 (no fallback) is genuinely closed in the code at :150-160.

escalate_question: Is the BOM check on claude-egress-check.ps1 accepted on the worker's byte evidence, or should the partner re-verify it once outside the reviewer channel? Option A: the partner runs `[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\scripts\cdp\claude-egress-check.ps1')[0..2]` in PowerShell 5.1 and confirms 239 187 191. The result is then final, and the delivery can pass. Option B: the partner accepts the worker's pasted evidence as sufficient. This is faster, but it sets the precedent that C5-type criteria can be closed by the worker's own paste when the reviewer has no byte-level access. Alternative: change the reviewer channel to include a read-only command so the check can be run by the reviewer. That is a permissions change outside the current phase, so I am not recommending it.
